description: Registar biciklističkih staza i taxi stajališta is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Vukovar. Register of bicycle paths and taxi stops. Coverage: Grad Vukovar. The portal shows the English title as "Register of bicycle paths and taxi stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grad Vukovar. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
